steps.title: Obtain the medical certificate of death
steps.explanation: Ask the hospital, attending doctor, or medical examiner for the medical certificate of cause of death. This is the first official record of the death and is required before civil registration.
steps.why_now: Every later certificate, funeral authorization, and claim depends on this medical record being issued first.
documents: Aadhaar or other ID of the deceased (if available)
steps.where: Hospital records desk, attending physician, or local medical examiner

steps.title: Register the death with the local civil authority
steps.explanation: Take the medical certificate to the municipal corporation, registrar of births and deaths, or equivalent local office so the death is entered in the civil register.
steps.why_now: Civil registration is what makes the death legally recorded and unlocks the official death certificate.
documents: Proof of address of the deceased
Relationship proof (if required by the registrar)
steps.where: Municipal corporation / registrar of births and deaths covering the place of death

steps.title: Apply for the official death certificate
steps.explanation: After registration, apply for certified copies of the death certificate. Banks, insurers, and courts will usually only accept this official copy, not the hospital form alone.
steps.why_now: You will need multiple certified copies for financial, insurance, and legal steps that follow.
steps.where: Same registrar office or the state/national civil registration portal

steps.title: Notify banks and freeze or transfer accounts
steps.explanation: Inform every bank and credit union where the deceased held accounts. Provide the official death certificate so accounts can be frozen, nominees paid, or funds moved into an estate account.
steps.why_now: Early notice reduces unauthorized withdrawals and starts nominee or estate processing while other claims are prepared.
documents: Bank nomination form or succession papers (if requested)
steps.where: Branch of each bank, or the bank's deceased-claim desk / app

steps.title: Apply for a legal heir or succession certificate
steps.explanation: Apply to the local revenue office or civil court for a legal heir certificate (or succession certificate where assets require it). This identifies who may claim remaining property, investments, and unpaid dues.
steps.why_now: After the death is certified, remaining assets and government claims typically cannot be settled without heirship proof.
documents: ID and address proof of all legal heirs
List of assets to be claimed
steps.where: Tahsildar / revenue office for a legal heir certificate, or district civil court for a succession certificate
